issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) and exponential backoff retry worker for failed domain event handlers
issues.body:
`lib/domain-events/consume.ts` processes incoming domain events, but if a subscriber handler throws an exception during event processing, the event is lost without retry or Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) storage.

## Why this matters
Transient network errors or temporary service outages should not cause loss of critical domain events (e.g. fund transfers, ownership changes, lifecycle mutations).

## Tasks
- [ ] Build Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) in `lib/domain-events/` to capture failed domain event payloads
- [ ] Implement exponential backoff retry worker with configurable max retry attempts (e.g. 3 attempts with 2s, 4s, 8s backoff)
- [ ] Add DLQ inspection UI on the operations dashboard allowing maintainers to inspect and manually replay failed events
- [ ] Add unit tests in `tests/__tests__/domain-events.test.ts` verifying DLQ capture and retry backoff timing

## Files to look at
- `lib/domain-events/consume.ts`
- `lib/domain-events/index.ts`
- `docs/DOMAIN_EVENTS.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- Failed domain event consumer handlers retry with exponential backoff before moving to DLQ
- Maintainers can inspect and re-trigger DLQ event payloads via the dashboard

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add real-time webhook alert triggers for domain invariant monitoring violations
issues.body:
`lib/invariant-monitor/` continuously checks system invariants (funds, ownership, authorization, lifecycle), but only logs violation reports without triggering instant alert notifications to external maintainer channels.

## Why this matters
Critical invariant breaches (such as fund balance discrepancies or unauthorized ownership mutations) require instant alert dispatch to maintainers.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement alert dispatcher in `lib/invariant-monitor/report.ts` supporting Webhooks (Slack, Discord, PagerDuty)
- [ ] Add configurable severity threshold rules (Critical violations trigger immediate alerts, Minor warnings batch into daily digests)
- [ ] Include violation diff context and affected record IDs in alert payload bodies
- [ ] Add unit tests in `tests/__tests__/invariant-monitor.test.ts` verifying webhook alert payload generation

## Files to look at
- `lib/invariant-monitor/report.ts`
- `lib/invariant-monitor/monitor.ts`
- `docs/INVARIANT_MONITORING.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- Invariant violations trigger immediate outbound webhook alert payloads
- High-severity breaches format clear diagnostic context for maintainer triage

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Build automated schema evolution compatibility tester for versioned domain events
issues.body:
`lib/domain-events/registry.ts` manages versioned event schemas, but lacks automated validation checking if schema updates introduce breaking changes (missing required fields, changed data types) against historic schema versions.

## Why this matters
Preventing breaking schema changes ensures backwards compatibility for event consumers across different deployed versions.

## Tasks
- [ ] Build automated schema compatibility checker in `scripts/validate-domain-events.ts`
- [ ] Enforce backward/forward compatibility rules (forbidding removal of required fields, enforcing default values for new fields)
- [ ] Wire schema evolution checks into `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying breaking vs non-breaking schema evolution detection

## Files to look at
- `lib/domain-events/registry.ts`
- `scripts/validate-domain-events.ts`
- `tests/__tests__/domain-events.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Domain event schema updates are validated against historic version definitions in CI
- Pull requests containing breaking schema changes fail CI verification

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement runtime secret rotation manager and environment variable sanitizer
issues.body:
`lib/config/env.ts` validates environment variables on startup, but does not support runtime secret rotation or sanitization of environment configurations leaked into client-side error tracebacks.

## Why this matters
Sensitive API keys and connection tokens must be masked in client-side logs and supported with smooth secret rotation without server restarts.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement secret sanitization mask in `lib/config/env.ts` redacting tokens from client tracebacks and logs
- [ ] Add runtime secret rotation listener reloading non-static environment configuration variables dynamically
- [ ] Add environment variable audit check flagging weak or default development secrets
- [ ] Add unit tests in `lib/config/__tests__/env.test.ts` for secret masking and rotation logic

## Files to look at
- `lib/config/env.ts`
- `scripts/validate-env.ts`
- `.env.example`

## Acceptance criteria
- Environment tokens are masked with `[SECRET_MASKED]` in browser logs and error traces
- Secret rotation updates dynamic environment config without requiring application rebuilds

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add debounced URL query state serializer for marketplace multi-facet filters
issues.body:

## Why this matters
Debouncing and optimizing URL query parameter serialization provides smooth browser back/forward navigation and shareable filter URLs.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement debounced URL state serializer hook in `app/marketplace/` using `use-debounce`
- [ ] Compact multi-select array parameters into clean compressed query strings (`?cat=ai,audit&sort=top`)
- [ ] Preserve filter state on page reload and browser back/forward navigation
- [ ] Add unit tests for URL query parameter serialization and deserialization

## Files to look at
- `app/marketplace/page.tsx`
- `features/agent-discovery/`
- `store/searchStore.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Marketplace filter changes update URL search parameters smoothly without jank
- Filter state is restored accurately when navigating via browser history buttons

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Build multi-signature transaction builder supporting threshold signers for Soroban DAO treasury
issues.body:
`features/governance/` supports single-key proposal execution, but lacks multi-signature transaction building and threshold signer collection for Soroban DAO treasury management.

## Why this matters
DAO treasury transfers require multi-signature approval (e.g. 3-of-5 signers) to prevent unauthorized fund movements.

## Tasks
- [ ] Build multi-sig transaction builder UI in `features/governance/` collecting multiple threshold signatures
- [ ] Display pending signature collection progress (e.g., 2/3 required signatures gathered)
- [ ] Export partially signed transaction envelopes (`XDR`) for off-chain co-signer review
- [ ] Add unit tests for multi-sig threshold validation and signature aggregation

## Files to look at
- `features/governance/`
- `lib/soroban/`
- `lib/governance/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Treasury proposal execution supports gathering multiple required signer signatures
- Partially signed transactions can be saved, shared, and completed by co-signers

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement WCAG 2.1 keyboard focus-trap manager for modals and drawer components
issues.body:
Modal overlays and side-drawer components in `components/` do not consistently trap keyboard focus, allowing keyboard Tab navigation to escape into hidden background elements.

## Why this matters
Keyboard focus management is a critical WCAG 2.1 requirement for screen reader and keyboard-only users.

## Tasks
- [ ] Build focus-trap utility hook (`useFocusTrap`) in `components/` restricting Tab navigation within active dialogs
- [ ] Automatically focus the primary input or close button when a modal opens
- [ ] Restore previous element focus when the modal or drawer closes
- [ ] Add automated Playwright keyboard navigation tests in `e2e/smoke.spec.ts`

## Files to look at
- `components/`
- `features/`
- `e2e/smoke.spec.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Keyboard Tab navigation is strictly trapped within open modal dialogs and drawers
- Closing a dialog returns keyboard focus to the triggering UI element

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add service worker version update prompt and immediate asset activation in PWA
issues.body:
`hooks/usePWA.ts` and `public/sw.js` handle service worker caching, but when a new deployment occurs, active users remain on outdated cached assets until all tabs are closed.

## Why this matters
Prompting users when a new application build is available ensures they benefit from latest features and security updates promptly.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add service worker update listener in `hooks/usePWA.ts` detecting `waiting` worker state
- [ ] Render unobtrusive update banner ('New version available! Reload to update')
- [ ] Trigger `skipWaiting()` and page reload when user accepts update prompt
- [ ] Add unit tests in `tests/pwa-utils.test.ts` for service worker lifecycle event handling

## Files to look at
- `hooks/usePWA.ts`
- `components/OfflineBanner.tsx`
- `public/sw.js`

## Acceptance criteria
- Users receive an update banner when a new service worker build is waiting
- Clicking reload activates the updated service worker and reloads the application

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Build IndexedDB database snapshot exporter and restore tool for offline state migration

- [ ] Add snapshot backup and restore UI in settings
- [ ] Add unit tests in `tests/__tests__/cache-manager.test.ts` verifying export and restore fidelity

- `app/settings/page.tsx`
- `tests/__tests__/cache-manager.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Users can export IndexedDB storage snapshots as downloadable files
- Restoring a snapshot reinstates offline drafts and cached state accurately

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement real-time log stream search and regex filter controls in agent telemetry
issues.body:
`app/telemetry/` displays real-time agent execution logs, but lacks live text search and regular expression (regex) filtering for isolating error lines during execution.

- [ ] Highlight matching search terms in the log viewer with step-to-step match navigation
- [ ] Add severity filter toggles (INFO, WARN, ERROR, DEBUG)
- [ ] Add unit tests for log stream filtering performance under 10,000+ line workloads

## Files to look at
- `app/telemetry/page.tsx`
- `features/agent-telemetry/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Telemetry log stream filters in real-time based on active regex patterns without freezing UI
- Search term matches are visually highlighted with previous/next navigation buttons

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add synthetic ping probes and latency tracking for external Stellar ecosystem services

- [ ] Record rolling p50/p95/p99 response latency metrics for each service
- [ ] Expose health probe metrics to status page endpoint `/api/operational-health`
- [ ] Add unit tests in `tests/__tests__/operational-health.test.ts` for probe timeout handling

## Files to look at
- `lib/operational-health.ts`
- `app/api/operational-health/route.ts`
- `tests/__tests__/operational-health.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Background probes track rolling p50/p95 response latencies for Horizon, Soroban RPC, and IPFS
- High latency or timeouts trigger degraded status indicators for affected sub-services

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement double-submit cookie anti-CSRF protection middleware for App Router mutations
issues.body:
App Router API endpoints in `app/api/` process state mutations, but lack double-submit cookie Anti-CSRF token verification for state-changing HTTP requests (`POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`).

## Why this matters
Anti-CSRF protection prevents unauthorized cross-site requests from executing actions on behalf of authenticated users.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement Anti-CSRF double-submit cookie middleware in `lib/security/` generating cryptographically secure tokens
- [ ] Include `X-CSRF-Token` header requirement on mutation endpoints in `lib/api.ts`
- [ ] Reject requests with invalid or missing CSRF tokens with HTTP 403 Forbidden
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying CSRF token generation, header validation, and rejection paths

## Files to look at
- `lib/api.ts`
- `lib/security/`
- `app/api/`

## Acceptance criteria
- API mutation endpoints require valid `X-CSRF-Token` headers matching secure double-submit cookies
- Unauthorized cross-site requests missing valid tokens are rejected with HTTP 403 status

- `lib/metric-definitions.ts`
- `lib/tests/idempotency.test.ts`

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement incremental search index updater for agent metadata mutations
issues.body:
`lib/search-indexing.ts` indexes agent metadata for search, but re-indexes the entire agent dataset on minor metadata updates, leading to CPU lag on large marketplace catalogs.

## Why this matters
Incremental search indexing updates only modified agent records, maintaining fast search responsiveness with minimal CPU overhead.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement single-record incremental index updater in `lib/search-indexing.ts` (`updateRecord`, `deleteRecord`)
- [ ] Add diff detector checking modified fields before triggering re-indexing
- [ ] Add unit tests in `tests/lib/search-indexing.test.ts` for incremental indexing vs full re-indexing

## Files to look at
- `lib/search-indexing.ts`
- `tests/lib/search-indexing.test.ts`
- `store/searchStore.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Modifying an agent metadata record updates only that record's search index entry
- Full index rebuilds are avoided during routine single-agent updates

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add network chaos simulation suite to E2E tests for testing latency and packet drop resilience
issues.body:
`e2e/journey.spec.ts` tests user flows under ideal network conditions, but does not test application resilience under simulated high latency, HTTP 500 errors, or packet loss.

## Why this matters
Automated network chaos testing verifies that fallback UIs, retries, and error boundaries function correctly during real-world network instability.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add Playwright route interceptor chaos utility in `e2e/` introducing artificial delay (500ms-3000ms) and random HTTP 5xx errors
- [ ] Add chaos test scenarios verifying loading skeletons, retry buttons, and error boundaries
- [ ] Include chaos testing suite execution in `.github/workflows/e2e.yml`
- [ ] Add acceptance assertion ensuring no unhandled React error boundary crashes occur under chaos conditions

## Files to look at
- `e2e/journey.spec.ts`
- `e2e/smoke.spec.ts`
- `playwright.config.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- E2E chaos tests verify application UI stability under simulated network delays and API failures
- Unhandled exceptions or blank screen crashes during chaos conditions fail the test suite
